name: 48 ~Zukei no Koi~
source:
In 48, you are an artist in Tokugawa shogunate period. What you do for a living is draw women. One day, you got a job asking you to draw 48 pictures of different sex positions.

[From [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=6&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
在《48》中，玩家将扮演德川幕府时代的一名画师，以描绘女性为生。一天，你接到一份工作，要绘制48幅表现不同性交体位的画。

[摘自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=6&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
